About

Fluindo is an LA-based/native electronic artist blending bossa nova, leftfield club, and organic downtempo. Their sound merges intricate rhythm with textured atmospheres, drawing from field recordings and generative processes. Rooted in both warmth and precision, Fluindo creates music that moves between intimacy and expanse.
